copy.shannon_comparison: By ordinary statistics, both machines look equally random.
copy.classical_attack: The attacker predicted every classical bit correctly.
copy.quantum_attack: On the quantum bits, the attacker did only slightly better than a coin flip.
copy.unpredictability_comparison: Each quantum bit holds far more genuine surprise than each classical bit.
copy.bias_note: Some qubits lean slightly toward 0 and others toward 1, with no overall direction.
